theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (ν : Measure X) (φ : X → ℝ × ℝ) (g : X → ℝ) (H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), ν univ ≠ ∞ → Measurable φ → AEStronglyMeasurable g ν → (∀ᵐ x ∂ν, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ 1) → AEMeasurable H volume → (∀ b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable b → ∫⁻ p : ℝ × ℝ, b p * H p = ∫⁻ x, b (φ x) * ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂ν) → (∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ, H p ≠ ∞) ∧ Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (H p).toReal) ∧ (∀ b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Measurable b → (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ p, |b p| ≤ M) → ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, b p * (H p).toReal = ∫ x, b (φ x) * g x ∂ν) ∧ ∀ S : Set (ℝ × ℝ), MeasurableSet S → ∫⁻ p in S, H p = ∫⁻ x in φ ⁻¹' S, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂ν
